discoveryCoverage: Four additional source IDs from the paired audit of multi-size and gradient tags. The other twelve IDs already occur in the existing special-scene registries.

cases.title: Conrad's enlarged greeting and return to ordinary speech
cases.invariant: Keep the abrupt enlarged greeting separate from the normal-sized question or request. The earlier greeting also uses the source gradient.
cases.adaptationRoute: Keep both meaningful text regions and the original TMP tag order. Review the wording in each branch before ordinary translation.
acceptanceScenarios: The greeting renders at 140% and the rest at 100%.
Emptying the greeting region is rejected before packaging.

cases.title: Conrad's smaller italic aside about scales
cases.invariant: Keep the hesitant aside smaller and italic between the observation and the ordinary-sized compliment.
cases.adaptationRoute: Retain the three visible regions and the original TMP tags. Review the aside in context.
acceptanceScenarios: The aside alone is italic and 70% before ordinary size returns.
Moving all wording out of the aside is rejected before packaging.

cases.title: Player's shrinking reply in Ryan's romance branch
cases.invariant: The selected reply starts at normal size and becomes progressively smaller across three successive hesitation beats.
cases.adaptationRoute: Keep separate audible-style hesitation beats in the source size stages without changing the choice ID or destination.
acceptanceScenarios: The choice remains legible and shows the 90%, 80% and 70% stages in order.
Emptying any text-bearing stage is rejected before packaging.
